note: Trees of the decoder of Table 5 (all non-zero digits alike) in which the joins below the top also filter a block of syndrome coordinates by distance, each at the worst rate of its cell. The parameters are those of jointtrees (ell and ell_d in bits) plus the blocks: per join j below the top the size and the error weight of its block (fractions of n), its syndrome filter, and its joint types at the joins above j. A forced block has at least the size 'size' at the join 'join'. search_failed marks a search that ended at a poor point.
